subject: Mediflow: advance-slab option, escrow milestone schedule & VAT evidence
messages:

Cc: Mediflow AP <ap@mediflow.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Terms & VAT logistics for pilot

Diego — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We are aligned on scope but AP pushed back on Net45 as a hard requirement for their policy. Two asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood do a 20% upfront / milestone escrow structure for the 3‑month pilot (so we can keep Net45 on the balance)?
2) AP needs explicit VAT evidence so they can reclaim — what docs do you need from us (VAT reg cert, EU subsidiary info, anything else)?

I've attached the latest SOW for reference. If we can get an invoice cadence + a simple escrow schedule, I can get procurement and legal to sign off quickly.

[attachment: SOW_Mediflow_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 324KB)]

— Samir

Mediflow Health
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir@mediflow.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-08T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Terms & VAT logistics for pilot

Hi Samir — appreciate the clear asks. Quick proposal so procurement can move: 

• Commercial structure: 20% upfront payment from Mediflow (cash receipt) to Redwood, remainder invoiced monthly with Net45 terms. 
• Escrow/milestone protection: Redwood agrees to place deliverable acceptance milestones into a simple escrow clause (release on milestone sign-off). We can draft a 3‑milestone schedule aligning to weeks 2 / 6 / 12 of the pilot.
• Credit/limit: For the pilot we can keep the invoice exposure capped at $150k. If monthly invoices exceed a threshold (2x expected), we trigger a manual review and require either an extra deposit or shortened terms.

VAT / tax evidence needed from you: 
- VAT registration certificate for the billing entity (Mediflow EU or Mediflow UK)
- Registered company name + VAT number that should appear on invoices
- If reverse-charge applies, a signed statement from AP (we can accept an AP email confirming reverse-charge intent)

I’ve attached our invoice template and a sample milestone schedule. Monica (Finance) and Laura (Legal) are cc’d to confirm the operational steps. If that all looks ok, Samir — can you confirm the billing entity and send VAT certs so we can issue the 20% proforma?

Attachments: Redwood-invoice-template.xlsx

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-09T08:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Terms & VAT logistics for pilot

Diego / Laura — flagging a couple of controls from Finance: 

1) Exposure cap: $150k for pilot is fine but recommend a soft condition: if total outstanding (A/R) > $120k at any monthly close, require a top‑up deposit to bring exposure below $100k. This reduces risk if invoices are delayed under Net45.
2) Credit check: request a one‑page credit confirmation from Mediflow (bank ref or credit agency report). If that is not available, we need a payment holdback (10%) until they provide it.
3) VAT handling: if Mediflow will reclaim VAT via reverse charge, ensure invoice shows net amounts + a reverse‑charge note. We will not rotate VAT invoices without a VAT cert on file.

Operational asks: Laura, can legal prepare a short addendum to the SOW that: (a) outlines 3 milestone releases; (b) specifies escrow release criteria; and (c) adds the exposure cap / top‑up mechanic?

cc: Karthik for billing system setup (I’ll need the exact billing entity).

– Monica
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2026-07-10T17:25:00Z
Subject: RE: Terms & VAT logistics for pilot

Diego / Monica / Karthik — I've drafted a one‑page SOW addendum and a short escrow schedule. Key points included: 

• Milestones: 
  - M1 (Week 2): integration + smoke test — release 40% of escrow
  - M2 (Week 6): pilot acceptance criteria met — release 30%
  - M3 (Week 12): final acceptance & runbook handoff — release remaining 30%

• Exposure mechanism: If outstanding > $120k at monthly close, Mediflow has 14 days to top up or we shorten terms to Net30 until balance clears.

• VAT: Invoices will show net amounts and include "reverse charge — Article 44" note. We will only mark invoices as VAT‑zero where we have the VAT cert on file.

Samir — Diego will send the 20% proforma once we confirm bank details and the payment reference. Please confirm acceptance of the addendum text in reply and we will attach to the SOW and route for signatures.

— Laura
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
